name: gettimeofday
synopsis: int gettimeofday(struct timeval *restrict tv, struct timezone *_Nullable restrict tz);
int settimeofday(const struct timeval *tv, const struct timezone *_Nullable tz);
description: The gettimeofday() function retrieves the current time and optionally the timezone information. It stores the time in a struct timeval, which includes seconds and microseconds since the Epoch. This function is considered obsolete in modern standards.

parameters.name: tv
parameters.description: Pointer to a struct timeval to store the current time (seconds and microseconds since the Epoch)

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: Pointer to a struct timezone to store timezone information, or NULL to ignore

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: One of tv or tz pointed outside the accessible address space

versions: On some architectures, implemented in vdso; kernel accepts NULL for tv and tz
